# Yogesh Bhavsar — Senior Frontend Engineer & Technical Architect

> Senior Frontend Engineer and Technical Architect with 7+ years of experience specializing in React, Next.js, Frontend Architecture, Core Web Vitals, and Web Performance Optimization. Available for small business website development, freelance frontend engineering, and technical consulting.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Small Business Website Development](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/web-development): Fast, modern, responsive websites designed to convert visitors into clients for founders and small businesses.
- [Freelance Frontend Engineering](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/frontend-development): Senior React and TypeScript engineering for product teams and growing startups.
- [React & Next.js Development](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/react-nextjs-development): Production App Router, Server Components, SSR, and clean scalable component hierarchies.
- [Frontend Architecture & Performance Consulting](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/frontend-consulting): Performance audits, Core Web Vitals fixes (LCP, INP, CLS), and design systems.

## Featured Products
- [FrontendYogi](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/projects/frontendyogi): Privacy-first browser utilities and developer workspaces with client-side file processing.
- [Writer Mirror](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/projects/writer-mirror): Focused writing interface with diagnostic workflows and rich text processing.
- [Her Sanctuary](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/projects/her-sanctuary): Content-led digital experience featuring brand architecture and accessible design systems.

## In-Depth Engineering Case Studies
- [Building Privacy-First Browser Tools](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/case-studies/privacy-first-browser-tools): Processing files locally in the browser, minimizing server uploads, and maintaining fast export workflows.
- [Designing a Better Image Comparison Tool](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/case-studies/image-comparison-ux): Interactive comparison UX with synchronized pan/zoom and difference visualization.
- [Building a Local-First Document and Presentation Workflow](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/case-studies/local-first-document-workflows): Trade-offs and architecture of browser-based document processing without cloud dependency.
- [Processing Large Photo Collections Locally](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/case-studies/local-photo-processing): High-throughput client-side media manipulation, caching, and batch exports.
- [Frontend Architecture for Complex Interactive Applications](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/case-studies/react-application-architecture): State management, bundle isolation, and component boundary strategies.
- [Building a Reliable Research Ingestion Workflow](https://yogeshbhavsar.com/case-studies/research-workflow-engineering): Parsing, caching, and resilient error recovery for data pipelines.
